title: Claim
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/pools/claim, application/json, with which the starter claims a request for one machine. The control plane queues work in each workspace, and a claim by one of that workspace's node pools takes the work the control plane chooses for that node pool. Without pool_id the claim covers the key's node pool, definitions.schema.json; with a pool_id that is not the key's node pool, the claim is refused, 403 forbidden, the same as an unknown one. The control plane holds the request up to wait_seconds while the claim can take no work, because none that it may take waits in its workspace's queue or the key's node pool is at its instance limit, and answers a signed 200 with claim-answer.schema.json when work can be claimed within that time, or a signed 204 with no body at its end. Each claimed dispatch takes a slot of the pool's instance limit at the claim, and the slot is freed once, at the first of these: the dispatch's release, release.schema.json; the lapse of its lease, which makes the dispatch stale when neither dispatched nor the redemption of its run code came before lease_until, claim-answer.schema.json; the end of the dispatch when the machine has not redeemed the run code within 15 minutes of the claim, or when the control plane ends the work it is for; or the end of the dispatch for any other reason. A stale dispatch holds no slot, though it has not ended. So the limit counts the pool's dispatches that are neither stale nor ended. A claim is refused, 409 no_gateway, when the choice of the key's node pool resolves to no gateway. It is signed with the pool's access key as definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the starter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

pool_id.description: The key's node pool, an optional check: any other value is refused, 403 forbidden.

wait_seconds.description: How long the control plane may hold the request while no work can be claimed, in seconds, from 0 to 25: 0 answers at once.
